verdict: Paid campaigns have not launched; five milestones are overdue and being resolved.
narrative: No paid activity ran this period — Meta and Google Ads show zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads across the full 28 days, because the planned ad launches from August 1 have not yet gone live. Five pre-launch milestones — including the stack test, LSA verification, site and landing pages, and both ad launches — are now more than five weeks past their deadlines. Google Business Profile had been your only source of inbound activity, generating 78 actions over the 28-day window, but that organic engagement dropped sharply in the last seven days and went to zero for the six most recent days. Resolving the overdue launch items is the immediate priority, and once campaigns are live you should expect paid traffic and leads to begin appearing in next week's data.
